sources.title: Change log base and divide by UTF-8 byte count
sources.details: For scored next-token events E, NLL=-Σ_e ln p_e. -Σ log2 p_e=NLL/ln2. BPB=NLL/(B ln2). EOS events may be included in E while B counts original text only, if stated consistently. This is the encoded sequence conditional cost under the chosen canonical encoding, not a claim that tokenization differences in event space disappear. Common raw exposure is Σ over400*8 sampled excerpts of UTF-8 byte lengths; does not match parameter or target counts.
